research.finding: Meaning, ichidan metadata, and both device examples accurately teach the switch-on sense. Add a German note tying this entry to the switch-on use (often 点ける/付ける) and distinguishing it from attaching, soaking, wearing, and other つける senses. research.finding: Reading, hayai, adjective classification, and the early example are correct. The second example contains 速くて rather than the entry spelling 早い, so it cannot silently serve as a retained 早い example. Add a German note distinguishing 早い (early/soon, sometimes quick) from 速い (speed) and provide two distinct examples using the intended spelling and senses. The revision must explain the orthographic distinction while retaining the legitimate prompt/quick sense of 早い.
